steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. The two listings match on everything I could see:

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Colour and box contents | Graphite, same accessories | Graphite, same accessories |

Nothing on the pages gives a reason to prefer one seller. The rating and review count are identical, so they may be shared product reviews rather than reviews of each seller. That means they don't tell you how reliable either seller is.

Some things you could check before you decide:
- **Seller reputation:** Look up each seller's independent reviews, for example on Trustpilot or the marketplace's seller feedback. This is the most useful tie-breaker.
- **Return policy details:** Check whether either one charges a restocking fee, even though the pages don't mention one.
- **Payment protection:** Pay with a credit card or PayPal so you're covered if something goes wrong.
- **Price at checkout:** Check for differences in tax or fees.

If none of that separates them, pick either one. If you've seen reviews or other details about either seller, tell me and I can compare again.
